title: Deleting a note removes it and its attachments from every inbox
custom_preconds:
1. Sign in as an Owner/Admin user (on a QA branch: the Admin quick-login button on the sign-in page; you appear as "Admin ShopView"). The Notifications page opens from the bell icon at the top right, next to your location name.
  2. A note you authored that tagged several recipients and carries an attachment: top menu Work Orders -> click a work order number (e.g. S2-4219) -> Notes tab -> New Note, type @ and pick "Tech ShopView" and another teammate, Save; then the note's menu ( ... ) -> Add attachment. Tech ShopView (Tech quick-login, private window) sees it in its inbox.
custom_steps:
1. Delete the note and confirm.
  2. Check the record no longer shows the note.
  3. Check every recipient's inbox no longer shows the notification.
  4. Confirm the attachment is gone.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Confirming removes the note from the record for everyone, removes the notification from the inbox of everyone it notified, and removes the note's attachments.

Source - where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-9667; story SV-10247 (S4, Delete a note); Notifications Update v1 PRD (Confluence 817463297), S4; design board DeleteNote; read 30 Sep 2026. Source-verified 30 September 2026.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S4-R5: “Confirming removes the note from the record for everyone.”
  • S4-R6: “Confirming removes the note from the inbox of everyone it notified.”
  • S4-R7: “Confirming removes the note's attachments.”

Last checked against build v26.40.7-7ffda69 on 10/5/2026.
